ambiguity: You asked for resilience to transient failures without saying which failures are safe to repeat, and the charge endpoint has no idempotency key.

facts.fact: Never retry a timeout. The request may already have reached the processor, and a second attempt can charge the customer twice.
A refused connection is safe to retry, because nothing was sent.
Two attempts in total at most.
We do not care about the delay between attempts.

stonewall: No strong view on that one - use your judgement.
